name: Queenstown Airport

hours.v: the airport operates 07:00 to 22:00 daily, under Civil Aviation Authority rules
hours.quote: Under Civil Aviation Authority rules, Queenstown Airport operates between 07:00 and 22:00 daily.

curfew.v: no movements outside the operating hours of 07:00 to 22:00 local (the operator states the airport operates only between these times)
curfew.quote: Under Civil Aviation Authority rules, Queenstown Airport operates between 07:00 and 22:00 daily.

ppr.v: general aviation aircraft over 5,700 kg MCTOW and other non-scheduled flights must send a movement request by email or the website before operating; the airport then allocates parking if it can take the flight
ppr.quote: For non-Regular Air Transport Operations and General Aviation operations with aircraft that exceed 5700kg MCTOW, you must submit a movement request to us by email or website prior to operating.

handling.v: aircraft parking on the main apron must nominate a licensed ground handling agent; the airport may require one wherever you park; irregular operations of aircraft 5,700 kg MCTOW or more are directed to a ground handler (Queenstown Corporate Jet Services named)
handling.quote: You are required to nominate a licensed Ground Handling Agent(s) for the provision of Ground Handling Services

slots.v: Queenstown is a schedules-facilitated airport (the document says Level 3) under the IATA Worldwide Scheduling Guidelines, for regular air transport; general aviation over 5,700 kg uses the movement request
slots.quote: Queenstown is classified as a Schedules Facilitated Airport (Level 3) in accordance with the airport levels classifications contained in the IATA Worldwide Scheduling Guidelines.

notes: 1 Nov 2026: added hours, curfew, ppr, handling and slots from Queenstown Airport's own pages: the 'Airport operations' page (operates 07:00-22:00 daily under CAA rules) and the Aeronautical Conditions of Use (in effect 1 Nov 2022, Version 2.2 of 1 Jul 2024; clause 5.3 movement request, clause 6.1 schedules facilitated, clause 14.1 ground handling agent). The curfew window is taken from the stated operating hours; the page uses no word 'curfew'. Only airlines certified for after-dark operations (Air New Zealand, Jetstar, Qantas, Virgin Australia per the page) fly after dark. Not opened (permission not granted in time): NZ AIP https://www.aip.net.nz/ and https://www.aip.net.nz/assets/AIP/Aerodromes-AD1/AERODROMES/NZQN_AD2.pdf, and the CAA booklet https://www.queenstownairport.co.nz/media/ahlhvgrz/in_out_and_around_queenstown.pdf. The old ACOU v4 URL and the v05 URL under /media/Corporate/ gave site errors. Runway, customs and fuel still need the AIP. NZ observes daylight time (NZDT UTC+13 in summer).
